description: This file defines data transfer objects (DTOs) for promotion-related requests and responses in a web service, specifically for applying coupons and handling API errors.

classes.name: ApplyCouponRequest
classes.description: DTO representing a request to apply a coupon code to an order or cart, including details like code, currency, subtotal, shipping, and tax.

classes.name: ApplyCouponResponse
classes.description: DTO representing the response after applying a coupon, including the discount, total amounts, and applied code.

classes.name: ApiErrorResponse
classes.description: DTO representing a standard structure for API error responses, including an error code and message.

methods.name: PromotionsDtos
methods.description: Private constructor used to prevent instantiation of the class as it serves as a container for DTOs.
